gloss: to be revived; to come back to life

definitions.gloss: to be resurrected; to come back to life
definitions.explanation: To return from death or apparent death; to be revived.

definitions.gloss: to be revived; to be restored
definitions.explanation: For something dormant, forgotten, or declining to regain vitality or prominence.

examples.japanese: {記憶|きおく}が{蘇|よみがえ}った。
{古|ふる}い{街|まち}が{蘇|よみがえ}った。
{心肺|しんぱい}{蘇生|そせい}で{彼|かれ}は{蘇|よみがえ}った。
{一度|いちど}{死|し}んだと{思|おも}われたが、{奇跡的|きせきてき}に{蘇|よみがえ}った。
examples.english: He was thought to have died, but miraculously came back to life.

examples.japanese: あの{曲|きょく}を{聞|き}くと、{学生|がくせい}{時代|じだい}の{思|おも}い{出|で}が{蘇|よみがえ}る。
examples.english: When I hear that song, memories of my student days come flooding back.

examples.japanese: {枯|か}れたと{思|おも}っていた{木|き}が{春|はる}になって{蘇|よみがえ}った。
examples.english: The tree I thought had died came back to life in spring.

examples.japanese: {修復|しゅうふく}{作業|さぎょう}によって、{古|ふる}い{絵画|かいが}が{蘇|よみがえ}った。
examples.english: Through restoration work, the old painting was brought back to life.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{不況|ふきょう}の{後|あと}、{商店街|しょうてんがい}に{活気|かっき}が{蘇|よみがえ}ってきた。
examples.english: After a long recession, vitality has returned to the shopping street.

examples.japanese: {溺|おぼ}れた{子供|こども}は{救急隊員|きゅうきゅうたいいん}の{懸命|けんめい}な{処置|しょち}で{蘇|よみがえ}った。
examples.english: The drowning child was revived by the paramedic's desperate efforts.

examples.japanese: {伝統|でんとう}{工芸|こうげい}を{蘇|よみがえ}らせようと、{若|わか}い{職人|しょくにん}たちが{努力|どりょく}している。
examples.english: Young craftspeople are working hard to revive traditional crafts.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No transitive pair.

WRITING: Also written as {甦|よみがえ}る or in hiragana.

ETYMOLOGY: From {黄泉|よみ} (the underworld in Japanese mythology) + {帰|かえ}る (to return).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{記憶|きおく}が{蘇|よみがえ}る (memories come back)
・{活気|かっき}が{蘇|よみがえ}る (vitality is restored)
・{思|おも}い{出|で}が{蘇|よみがえ}る (memories revive)

RELATED:
・{蘇生|そせい} (resuscitation)
・{復活|ふっかつ} (revival, resurrection)
